title: Implementing municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility: A spatial diagnosis of Kraków in the context of urban planning reforms
title_zh: 实施软性基础设施可达性的市政标准：城市规划改革背景下克拉科夫的空间诊断
title_primary: 实施软性基础设施可达性的市政标准：城市规划改革背景下克拉科夫的空间诊断
title_secondary: Implementing municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility: A spatial diagnosis of Kraków in the context of urban planning reforms
authors: Artur Wierzbicki, Anita Kukulska-Kozieł, Józef Hernik
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Dynamic urbanisation processes in Poland, including land development pressure and oversupply of buildable land, pose increasing challenges in ensuring equal access to soft infrastructure for local populations. These problems are addressed in the 2023 amendment to the Act on spatial planning and development. It allows for defining municipal standards for soft infrastructure accessibility in master plans. The study diagnoses the spatial accessibility of the infrastructure in Kraków and evaluates the compliance of the existing soft infrastructure with the new statutory standards. Its novelty lies in being the first attempt at operationalising the new regulations in an empirical analysis that uses network-based GIS methodology. The analyses were performed with the QNEAT3 plugin for QGIS using the statutory distance limits. The results show that 77% and 93% of parcels in Kraków conform to school and public green spaces accessibility criteria, respectively. However, only 56% of the city area has access to both types of soft infrastructure simultaneously; eastern and peripheral parts of the city are clearly disadvantaged. Overall, Kraków is relatively well prepared to implement soft infrastructure accessibility standards, but the findings revealed an integration gap across housing, transport, and environmental policies. The evidence can serve as a reference for other municipalities in Poland and internationally, including in Eastern European countries, following the sociopolitical transformation for implementing new spatial planning tools.
abstract_zh: 波兰动态城市化进程，包括土地开发压力及可建设用地供应过剩，对确保当地居民平等享有软性基础设施带来了日益严峻的挑战。这些问题在2023年《空间规划与发展法》修正案中得到回应，该修正案允许在总体规划中定义软性基础设施可达性的市政标准。本研究诊断了克拉科夫基础设施的空间可达性，并评估了现有软性基础设施与新法定标准的符合情况。其创新之处在于首次尝试将新规应用于实证分析，采用基于网络的GIS方法。分析利用QGIS的QNEAT3插件，依据法定距离限制进行。结果显示，克拉科夫77%和93%的地块分别符合学校和公共绿地可达性标准。然而，仅有56%的城市区域能同时获得两类软性基础设施；城市东部和边缘地区明显处于劣势。总体而言，克拉科夫在实施软性基础设施可达性标准方面准备相对充分，但研究结果揭示了住房、交通和环境政策之间的整合缺口。该证据可为波兰及其他国际地区，包括经历社会政治转型后的东欧国家，在实施新空间规划工具时提供参考。

title: Hedonic Modeling for Fed Cattle Price Reporting and Market Transparency
title_zh: 联邦牛价格报告的享乐模型与市场透明度
title_primary: 联邦牛价格报告的享乐模型与市场透明度
title_secondary: Hedonic Modeling for Fed Cattle Price Reporting and Market Transparency
authors: Jason Franken, Haluk Gedikoglu, Theodoros Skevas, Mary Hendrickson
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Livestock Mandatory Reporting Act of 1999 was enacted to facilitate price reporting and increase market transparency. With immense structural change in the cattle industry, current practices of reporting weighted average prices are becoming less meaningful. Recent studies indicate that with the collection of additional data beyond what is currently available under the act, hedonic modeling may hold potential to facilitate more meaningful price reporting. This study revisits the issue using transaction level prices from four beef packers and finds incorporating the recommended information improves hedonic models' representation of prices. Though improved model specification enhances coefficient consistency, with particularly promising results for quality grades, remaining variation in sign and significance of other daily estimated coefficients undermines the approach's ability to inform intuitive premiums and discounts for some characteristics. Future research may explore on balance the relative merit of further improvement in data collection, model specification, and increasing observations with longer multiday rolling regressions to facilitate price reporting.
abstract_zh: 1999年《牲畜强制报告法案》旨在促进价格报告并提高市场透明度。随着养牛业经历巨大结构性变革，当前报告加权平均价格的做法正逐渐失去意义。近期研究表明，若在该法案现有基础上收集更多数据，特征价格模型可能有助于实现更具意义的价格报告。本研究利用四家牛肉加工企业的交易层面价格数据重新审视此问题，发现纳入推荐信息可改善特征价格模型对价格的呈现。尽管改进的模型设定增强了系数一致性，尤其在质量等级方面结果颇具前景，但其他日常估计系数的符号和显著性仍存在波动，这削弱了该方法为某些特征提供直观溢价和折价信息的能力。未来研究可权衡进一步改进数据收集、模型设定以及通过延长多日滚动回归增加观测值的相对价值，以促进价格报告。

title: Falling Dominoes? The Impact of the US Exit from Free Trade on the Sustainability of Trade Cooperation
title_zh: 倒下的多米诺骨牌？美国退出自由贸易对贸易合作可持续性的影响
title_primary: 倒下的多米诺骨牌？美国退出自由贸易对贸易合作可持续性的影响
title_secondary: Falling Dominoes? The Impact of the US Exit from Free Trade on the Sustainability of Trade Cooperation
authors: Barthelemy Bonadio, Andrei Levchenko, Nitya Pandalai-Nayar
official: 官方在线 2026-05-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper quantitatively evaluates other countries' optimal tariffs and the prospects of sustaining international trade cooperation when a large player — the United States — exits the cooperative trade regime. To guide the analysis, we rely on an analytical characterization of the optimal tariff in a simplified multi-country trade model with endogenous labor supply. A country's optimal import tariffs are a function of its trade partners' expenditure shares on its goods, and the trade and labor supply elasticities. In both the simplified model and the full quantitative multi-country, multi-sector global network model, the impact of the US withdrawal from free trade on other countries' optimal tariffs and the sustainability of the cooperative trade regime is minimal. This is because quantitatively, the key determinants of these objects — domestic and international trade shares of other countries — change little from the US withdrawal. This main finding is not sensitive to the trade or labor supply elasticities. Thus, the fall of the US free trade domino is unlikely to cause further dominoes to fall.
abstract_zh: 本文定量评估了当一个大国——美国——退出合作贸易体制时，其他国家的关税最优水平及维持国际贸易合作的前景。为引导分析，我们依赖于一个简化多国贸易模型中关税最优水平的解析特征，该模型包含内生劳动供给。一个国家的进口关税最优水平是其贸易伙伴对其商品支出份额以及贸易和劳动供给弹性的函数。在简化模型和完整的定量多国、多部门全球网络模型中，美国退出自由贸易对其他国家的关税最优水平及合作贸易体制可持续性的影响微乎其微。这是因为从数量上看，这些对象的关键决定因素——其他国家的国内和国际贸易份额——在美国退出后变化不大。这一主要发现对贸易或劳动供给弹性并不敏感。因此，美国自由贸易多米诺骨牌的倒下不太可能导致更多骨牌相继倒下。

title: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
title_zh: 中低收入国家儿童保育对女性劳动供给和儿童发展的影响
title_primary: 中低收入国家儿童保育对女性劳动供给和儿童发展的影响
title_secondary: The Effect of Childcare on Female Labor Supply and Child Development in Low and Middle Income Countries
authors: Serena Goldberg, Costas Meghir
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Childcare services can offer an opportunity for women to develop their careers and increase household income. At the same time, it can affect the development of children, depending on the quality of care. We first develop a collective model of the household as a conceptual framework to show how improving the availability of childcare can affect mothers’ labor market opportunities and earnings and how it can affect child development. We then review the literature on the effects of childcare on the employment and earnings of women and on child development. Childcare can increase mothers’ employment. However, limited work opportunities or strict norms against maternal work can keep mothers out of the labor force. When other family members provide care, childcare can free these caregivers to work or attend school. When studies measure the impact on child development, the results are mixed and depend on both context and quality of provision.
abstract_zh: 育儿服务能为女性提供发展职业生涯和增加家庭收入的机会。同时，根据照护质量的不同，它也可能影响儿童的发展。我们首先构建了一个家庭集体模型作为概念框架，用以说明改善育儿服务的可及性如何影响母亲的劳动力市场机会和收入，以及如何影响儿童发展。随后，我们回顾了关于育儿服务对女性就业、收入及儿童发展影响的文献。育儿服务可以提高母亲的就业率。然而，有限的工作机会或对母亲就业的严格社会规范可能使母亲留在劳动力市场之外。当其他家庭成员提供照护时，育儿服务可以解放这些照护者，使其能够工作或上学。在衡量对儿童发展影响的研究中，结果不一，且取决于具体情境和服务的质量。

title: The Political Economy of Early COVID-19 Interventions in US States
title_zh: 美国各州早期COVID-19干预措施的政治经济学
title_primary: 美国各州早期COVID-19干预措施的政治经济学
title_secondary: The Political Economy of Early COVID-19 Interventions in US States
authors: Martin Gonzalez-Eiras, Dirk Niepelt, John Lewis
official: 官方在线 2022-01-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate how politico-economic factors shaped government responses to the spread of COVID-19. Our simple framework uses epidemiological, economic and politico-economic arguments. Confronting the theory with US state level data we find strong evidence for partisanship even when we control for fundamentals including the electorate's political views. Moreover, we detect an important role for the proximity of elections which we interpret as indicative of career concerns. Finally, we find suggestive evidence for complementarities between voluntary activity reductions and government imposed restrictions.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了政治经济因素如何影响政府对COVID-19传播的应对措施。我们的简明框架融合了流行病学、经济学及政治经济学论点。将理论与美国州级数据相对照，我们发现，即便在控制包括选民政治观点在内的基本面因素后，党派偏见的影响依然显著。此外，我们识别出选举临近性的重要作用，这被解读为职业关切的体现。最后，我们获得了关于自愿活动减少与政府强制限制之间存在互补性的初步证据。

title: Mechanized Fragility in Turkish Agriculture: Earthquakes, Capital Destruction and the Scarcity Trap
title_zh: 土耳其农业的机械化脆弱性：地震、资本破坏与稀缺陷阱
title_primary: 土耳其农业的机械化脆弱性：地震、资本破坏与稀缺陷阱
title_secondary: Mechanized Fragility in Turkish Agriculture: Earthquakes, Capital Destruction and the Scarcity Trap
authors: Alper Demirdogen, Emine Olhan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Natural disasters increasingly threaten global food security, yet the resilience of mechanized, middle‐income agriculture remains a puzzle. Standard development theory suggests households manage shocks by substituting labor for capital. We show this mechanism fails in modern, mechanized agriculture because substituting labor for destroyed capital is infeasible in the short run. We estimate the impact of the February 2023 earthquakes in Turkiye on agricultural supply, separating extensive margin adjustments (cultivated land) from intensive margin effects (yields). This disaster represents a unique ‘dual shock’: physical capital destruction coincided with a liquidity crisis that blocked asset replacement. To analyse this, we adapt the Agricultural Household Model using a Leontief (fixed‐proportions) representation as a short‐run limiting case. Empirically, we employ a Synthetic Difference‐in‐Differences strategy, combining district‐level crop statistics with remote sensing data. We find a significant contraction at the extensive margin: wheat cultivation declined by 8.5% relative to the pre‐treatment mean in the 2024‐restricted specification. Yet, we identify a ‘Null Yield Effect’ at the intensive margin. Yields remained stable or increased. This aligns with ‘Ricardian Selection,’ where producers—facing binding capital constraints—abandon marginal lands to concentrate resources on prime plots; consistent with this mechanism, the yield gain is concentrated in marginal, low‐quality districts and absent where land is better. Sharp declines in new tractor registrations (24%) and agricultural credit (16.5%) confirm a ‘Scarcity Trap.’ In high‐inflation, mechanized environments, cash transfers are insufficient. Policy must instead prioritize in‐kind capital replacement to bypass liquidity constraints and restore capacity.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害日益威胁全球粮食安全，然而机械化、中等收入农业的韧性仍是一个未解之谜。标准发展理论认为，家庭通过以劳动力替代资本来应对冲击。我们证明，这一机制在现代机械化农业中失效，因为在短期内以劳动力替代被摧毁的资本并不可行。我们估算了2023年2月土耳其地震对农业供给的影响，将集约边际调整（耕地面积）与广延边际效应（单产）区分开来。此次灾害构成了一次独特的“双重冲击”：物质资本毁坏与流动性危机同时发生，后者阻碍了资产重置。为分析这一问题，我们采用Leontief（固定比例）生产函数作为短期极限情形，对农业家庭模型进行了适应性改造。在实证方面，我们采用合成双重差分策略，将区级作物统计数据与遥感数据相结合。我们发现广延边际出现显著收缩：在2024年限制性设定中，小麦种植面积较处理前均值下降8.5%。然而，我们在集约边际识别出“零单产效应”——单产保持稳定甚至有所上升。这与“李嘉图选择”相一致，即面临资本约束的生产者放弃边际土地，将资源集中于优质地块；与该机制一致的是，单产增益集中在边际、低质量地区，而在土地质量较好的地区则不存在。新拖拉机注册量（下降24%）和农业信贷（下降16.5%）的急剧减少证实了“稀缺陷阱”的存在。在高通胀、机械化的环境中，现金转移支付不足以解决问题。政策应优先采取实物资本重置的方式，以绕过流动性约束并恢复生产能力。

title: Wars, threats, and the sovereign bond market
title_zh: 战争、威胁与主权债券市场
title_primary: 战争、威胁与主权债券市场
title_secondary: Wars, threats, and the sovereign bond market
authors: Federle, Jonathan-Julian, Greenwood, Robin, Meyer, Josefin, Reinhart, Carmen M., Trebesch, Christoph
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study how wars and military threats affect financial markets. Leveraging more than 300,000 monthly price observations since 1822, we create an external currency bond index for more than 90 countries - the EXBI. Using the EXBI, we document large effects of wars on returns and borrowing costs. In a global external bond portfolio, a one-standard-deviation war shock lowers returns by five percentage points. At the country level, wars at home generate sharp losses and increase default risk. Military threats depress bond prices in threatened states, but not in threatening ones, highlighting their role as a channel for eoeconomic coercion.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨战争与军事威胁如何影响金融市场。利用自1822年以来超过30万个月度价格观测数据，我们构建了一个覆盖90多个国家的外部货币债券指数——EXBI。借助EXBI，我们记录了战争对回报率和借贷成本的显著影响。在全球外部债券组合中，一个标准差战争冲击会使回报率下降五个百分点。在国家层面，本土战争导致剧烈损失并增加违约风险。军事威胁压低受威胁国家的债券价格，但对威胁发起国无此影响，凸显了其作为经济胁迫渠道的作用。

title: Ecosystem services supplied by urban green corridors with varying degrees of community involvement
title_zh: 不同社区参与程度的城市绿色廊道生态系统服务供给
title_primary: 不同社区参与程度的城市绿色廊道生态系统服务供给
title_secondary: Ecosystem services supplied by urban green corridors with varying degrees of community involvement
authors: Kara Rüber, Lars Bodum, Thomas Elliot
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Ensuring the provision of and access to ecosystem services is crucial to environmental health and human well-being. This study assesses the potential of urban green corridors (UGCs) to accommodate diverse interests, including by supplying ecosystem services, highlighting emerging socio-ecological conflicts. Five global UGCs are analysed as case studies through an ecosystem service assessment. A mixed qualitative and quantitative methodology is applied. The role of local communities is explored in context with the ecosystem service results. The key findings indicate that multiple ecosystem services such as local climate regulation, air quality regulation, flood protection, pollination, and recreational and aesthetic values can be supplied by these UGCs, while some provide educational and scientific research opportunities. However, the UGCs vary in their potential supply of ecosystem services due to unique case-specific characteristics. Achieving a balance between ecological and societal needs remains challenging due to conflicting interests, while infrastructure is often being prioritised, resulting in critical ecological impacts. Limited financial resources, expertise, and stakeholder collaboration challenge the long-term management of UGCs that impacts the supply of ecosystem services. The public's use of these spaces can result in disturbances and conflicts impacting the supply of ecosystem services. UGCs have the potential to serve as multifunctional spaces that address societal needs by providing ecosystem services and other benefits, such as connectivity and supporting social interaction and active mobility. However, further site-specific research is needed to investigate and enhance the supply of ecosystem services, including interactions between ecosystem services.
abstract_zh: 确保生态系统服务的供给与获取对于环境健康和人类福祉至关重要。本研究评估了城市绿色廊道（UGCs）在容纳多元利益方面的潜力，包括通过提供生态系统服务，并凸显新兴的社会生态冲突。以五个全球城市绿色廊道为案例，通过生态系统服务评估进行分析。采用定性与定量相结合的混合方法。结合生态系统服务结果，探讨了当地社区的作用。主要发现表明，这些城市绿色廊道能够提供多种生态系统服务，如局部气候调节、空气质量调节、洪水防护、授粉以及休闲和美学价值，部分还提供教育和科学研究机会。然而，由于各案例特有的特征，城市绿色廊道在生态系统服务供给潜力上存在差异。由于利益冲突，实现生态与社会需求之间的平衡仍具挑战性，而基础设施往往被优先考虑，导致严重的生态影响。有限的财政资源、专业知识及利益相关者合作，对城市绿色廊道的长期管理构成挑战，进而影响生态系统服务的供给。公众对这些空间的使用可能导致干扰和冲突，影响生态系统服务的供给。城市绿色廊道有潜力作为多功能空间，通过提供生态系统服务及其他益处（如连通性、支持社会互动和积极出行）来满足社会需求。然而，仍需进一步针对具体地点的研究，以探究和增强生态系统服务的供给，包括生态系统服务之间的相互作用。

title: Intergenerational Sharing of Unhedgeable Inflation Risk
title_zh: 不可对冲通胀风险的代际分担
title_primary: 不可对冲通胀风险的代际分担
title_secondary: Intergenerational Sharing of Unhedgeable Inflation Risk
authors: Damiaan Chen, Roel Beetsma, Sweder van Wijnbergen
official: 官方在线 2022-12-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We explore how members of a collective pension scheme can share inflation risks in the absence of suitable financial market instruments. Using intergenerational risk sharing arrangements, risks can be allocated better across the various participants of a collective pension scheme than would be the case in a strictly individual- or cohort-based pension scheme, as these can only lay off risks via existing financial market instruments. Hence, intergenerational sharing of these risks enhances welfare. In view of the sizes of their funded pension sectors, this would be particularly beneficial for the Netherlands and the U.K.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在缺乏合适金融市场工具的情况下，集体养老金计划的成员如何能够分担通货膨胀风险。通过代际风险分担安排，相较于严格基于个人或群体的养老金计划，这些风险能够在集体养老金计划的不同参与者之间得到更优的配置，因为后者仅能通过现有的金融市场工具来转移风险。因此，代际间对这些风险的分担增进了福利。鉴于其基金制养老金部门的规模，这对荷兰和英国尤为有利。

title: The transmission of shocks across sectors and the dynamics of sectoral prices
title_zh: 跨部门冲击的传导与部门价格动态
title_primary: 跨部门冲击的传导与部门价格动态
title_secondary: The transmission of shocks across sectors and the dynamics of sectoral prices
authors: Monti, Francesca & Van Keirsbilck, Leïla
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the dynamics of U.S. sectoral producer prices in a large Bayesian Vector Auto Regression (BVAR) model where the Input-Output (IO) matrix is used to structure their long-run relationships. The model provides evidence of a sectoral spillover channel in driving headline inflation without imposing such a mechanism in the model’s structure. Forecasts of headline inflation have accuracy comparable to the Survey of Professional Forecasters’ and greater than those generated by a standard BVAR with the Minnesota prior, confirming that the IO matrix long-run prior conveys relevant information about the data. The study of an oil price shock shows that adding the production network prior alters the transmission of the shock, amplifying headline inflation. Across sectors, the peak price response to the oil shock increases with oil intensity. A narrowly sector-specific disturbance, such as a cereal price shock, has non-negligible aggregate effects once the production network is accounted for. Sectoral asymmetries are crucial for evaluating the macroeconomic consequences of macroeconomic shocks such as an energy price shock and a monetary policy shock, as industries with slower price adjustments amplify inflation persistence, even after the shock dissipates. JEL Classification: C11, C55, E30
abstract_zh: 本文在一个大型贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型中研究了美国部门生产者价格的动态，其中投入产出（IO）矩阵被用于构建其长期关系。该模型提供了部门溢出渠道驱动总体通胀的证据，而无需在模型结构中施加此类机制。总体通胀的预测精度与专业预测者调查相当，且高于使用明尼苏达先验的标准BVAR模型所生成的预测，证实了IO矩阵长期先验传达了关于数据的相关信息。对油价冲击的研究表明，加入生产网络先验改变了冲击的传导，放大了总体通胀。在各行业间，价格对油价冲击的峰值响应随石油强度增加而上升。一个狭窄的部门特定扰动，如谷物价格冲击，在考虑生产网络后具有不可忽视的总体效应。部门不对称性对于评估宏观经济冲击（如能源价格冲击和货币政策冲击）的宏观经济后果至关重要，因为价格调整较慢的行业会放大通胀持续性，即使在冲击消退后也是如此。JEL分类：C11, C55, E30

abstract: A significant increase in household debt occurred in the United States before the Great Recession. This study examines variations in debt-to-income ratios across local areas at the onset of the recession to understand how exposure to debt affected unincorporated self-employment and its average income during and after the downturn. It shows that the adverse effects of the recession on self-employment outcomes were more pronounced in areas that experienced larger household debt shocks. Furthermore, analysis of the following years indicates that the impact on self-employment persisted for a few more years after the recession ended.

official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies how geopolitical risk shapes financial fragmentation and international risk-sharing, using bilateral official lending data from 1910 to 2024. We document that when geopolitical risk is high, bilateral lending increasingly follows geopolitical alignment. Because geopolitically aligned countries experience more synchronized shocks, this fragmentation limits the effectiveness of international risk-sharing. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce geopolitical considerations into a limited-commitment model of sovereign borrowing. The model shows that, even with non-discriminatory default, higher geopolitical tensions redirect international lending toward allied countries and weaken risk-sharing.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1910年至2024年的双边官方贷款数据，研究地缘政治风险如何塑造金融碎片化与国际风险分担。我们发现，当地缘政治风险较高时，双边贷款日益遵循地缘政治结盟。由于地缘政治结盟国家经历更为同步的冲击，这种碎片化限制了国际风险分担的有效性。为合理化这些模式，我们将地缘政治考量引入主权借款的有限承诺模型。模型表明，即使存在非歧视性违约，更高的地缘政治紧张局势也会将国际贷款引向盟国，并削弱风险分担。

title: Profits and Social Impacts: Complements vs. Tradeoffs for Lenders in Three Countries
title_zh: 利润与社会影响：三国贷款机构中的互补与权衡
title_primary: 利润与社会影响：三国贷款机构中的互补与权衡

authors: Susan Athey, Bruno Fava, Dean Karlan, Adam Osman, Jonathan Zinman
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The canonical approach to corporate governance posits a tradeoff between maximizing shareholder profits and maximizing other aspects of shareholder welfare such as social impact. Advances in machine learning that enhance the firm's ability to target specific customers may exacerbate or ameliorate this tradeoff. We estimate these tradeoffs using data from randomized microcredit approvals in South Africa, the Philippines, and Bosnia. We examine social impact on two dimensions: credit access (i.e., reaching disadvantaged groups that typically have less access to financial markets) and impact (i.e., treatment effects on household income). Two of the three lenders could have increased average loan profit margin by 7–9 percentage points through machine learning-based targeting. However, such targeting pushes against social impact goals vis-à-vis credit access; specifically, women and lower-income households would have been more excluded (the implied impact on borrowers' income, also central to the dual goal of social impact, is too imprecisely estimated to draw an inference). To gauge the magnitude of the first tradeoff, we examine how profits would change if the lenders altered whom they lent to within each quintile of baseline borrower income, thus holding the distribution broadly similar but fine-tuning the targeting within income bands. Such a constraint would lower the profit gains of targeting by about half. These findings highlight the importance of quantifying tradeoffs and complementarities when deciding what to maximize.
abstract_zh: 公司治理的经典理论认为，股东利润最大化与股东福利（如社会影响）最大化之间存在权衡。机器学习技术的进步增强了企业精准定位特定客户的能力，这可能加剧或缓解这一权衡。我们利用南非、菲律宾和波斯尼亚随机小额信贷审批数据，从两个维度评估社会影响：信贷可及性（即覆盖通常难以进入金融市场的弱势群体）和实际影响（即对家庭收入的处理效应）。三家贷款机构中有两家可通过基于机器学习的精准定位将平均贷款利润率提高7-9个百分点。然而，这种精准定位会与信贷可及性方面的社会目标产生冲突：具体而言，女性和低收入家庭将被更严重地排斥在外（对借款人收入的影响——这一社会影响双重目标的核心要素——因估计精度不足而无法得出明确结论）。为衡量第一种权衡的规模，我们考察了若贷款机构在基准借款人收入的每个五分位区间内调整放贷对象（即保持收入分布大致相似但优化收入区间内的精准定位），利润将如何变化。这种约束会使精准定位带来的利润增益降低约一半。这些发现凸显了在决策最大化目标时量化权衡与互补关系的重要性。

title: Is irregular migration responsive to recent German asylum policy adjustments?
title_zh: 德国近期庇护政策调整是否对非正规移民产生了影响？
title_primary: 德国近期庇护政策调整是否对非正规移民产生了影响？
title_secondary: Is irregular migration responsive to recent German asylum policy adjustments?
authors: Bernd Beber, Cara Ebert, Maximiliane Sievert
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate the extent to which asylum policies that aim to deter individuals from migrating irregularly in fact do so. We specifically consider effects of Germany’s 2023 asylum policy adjustments, which include accelerated asylum decision processes, the prospect of asylum processing outside of Europe, the introduction of a payment card to replace cash benefits, and an extended waiting period for native-level benefits. To estimate the effects of these policy measures on irregular migration intent, we implement a conjoint experiment with 989 men aged 18–40 in four cities in Senegal, a country where irregular migration to Europe is highly salient. Offshoring the asylum process substantially lowers irregular migration intentions, and extending the waiting time for native-level benefits only has a small effect on intent. Neither reducing asylum processing times nor replacing cash benefits with a payment card alters intentions. Our study does not resolve political and normative questions concerning these policies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在阻止个人非正规移民的庇护政策在多大程度上实际发挥了作用。我们特别关注德国2023年庇护政策调整的影响，包括加速庇护决策流程、将庇护处理程序转移至欧洲以外地区、引入支付卡替代现金福利，以及延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期。为评估这些政策对非正规移民意愿的影响，我们在塞内加尔四个城市对989名18至40岁男性实施了一项联合实验——该国非正规移民至欧洲的现象尤为突出。研究发现，将庇护程序外包至欧洲以外地区显著降低了非正规移民意愿，而延长获得与本国居民同等福利的等待期仅对意愿产生微弱影响。缩短庇护处理时间或用支付卡替代现金福利均未改变移民意愿。本研究未就这些政策涉及的政治与规范性问题作出定论。

title: Walking with Feet Tied to the Past: Childhood Exposure to the 1918 Influenza Pandemic and Later-Life Male Mortality
title_zh: 背负过往前行：童年经历1918年流感大流行与晚年男性死亡率
title_primary: 背负过往前行：童年经历1918年流感大流行与晚年男性死亡率
title_secondary: Walking with Feet Tied to the Past: Childhood Exposure to the 1918 Influenza Pandemic and Later-Life Male Mortality
authors: Hamid Noghanibehambari, Jason Fletcher
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Many previous studies have used cross-cohort comparisons and a focus on in utero exposure to document the lingering effects of the 1918 influenza pandemic on survivors’ outcomes later in life. A subset has examined impacts on old-age health and mortality, finding mixed results. This paper contributes to the literature by extending the analysis to evaluate early-life and childhood exposure to the pandemic on old-age longevity along with a set of candidate mechanisms. We employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and employ event-study and difference-in-difference regressions to compare longevity of cohorts with different age-at-exposure who were born in cities with high versus low exposure based on 1918 influenza-related mortality. Our treatment-on-treated calculations suggest that cohorts with age-at-exposure of 3-8 and 9-11 experience 6.4 and 11.2 months reductions in old age longevity; importantly, we note that these cohorts are often used as “controls” in the broader literature. While our main analysis focuses on males due to data constraints, supplementary results suggest smaller and less precise effects for females. An analysis of census data suggests reductions in health, education and socioeconomic scores as potential mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 许多先前研究通过跨队列比较并聚焦于子宫内暴露，记录了1918年流感大流行对幸存者晚年生活结果的持续影响。部分研究考察了其对老年健康与死亡率的影响，但结果不一。本文通过将分析扩展至评估早期生活及童年时期暴露于大流行对老年寿命的影响，并探讨一系列潜在机制，为现有文献做出贡献。我们利用与社会保障管理局死亡记录关联的1940年全量人口普查数据，采用事件研究法和双重差分回归，比较了不同暴露年龄队列的寿命差异——这些队列出生于1918年流感相关死亡率高或低的城市。基于处理效应的计算表明，暴露年龄为3-8岁和9-11岁的队列，其老年寿命分别缩短6.4个月和11.2个月；重要的是，我们注意到这些队列在更广泛的文献中常被用作“对照组”。由于数据限制，我们的主要分析聚焦于男性，但补充结果显示女性受到的影响较小且估计精度较低。对人口普查数据的分析表明，健康、教育及社会经济得分的下降是潜在机制。

title: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
title_zh: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性
title_primary: 动态偏好“逆转”与时间不一致性
title_secondary: Dynamic Preference "Reversals" and Time Inconsistency
authors: Philipp Strack, Dmitry Taubinsky
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the possibility of identifying time-inconsistent preferences in empirical designs where preferences are elicited in advance at time 0 and then again at time 1, after the agent receives additional information. For single-peaked preferences, time consistency is rejected only when the time-1 ranking between a pair of alternatives is always the reverse of the time-0 ranking. We establish variations and generalizations of this result. Since such stark reversals are rarely observed, choice-revision designs require stronger identification assumptions than perhaps previously appreciated. But we show that time inconsistency is identifiable in environments where preferences over alternatives can be “priced out.” (JEL D11, D15, D83, D86)
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在实证设计中识别时间不一致偏好的可能性，其中偏好是在时间0提前引出，并在时间1（代理人获得额外信息后）再次引出。对于单峰偏好，只有当时间1对某对备选方案的排序始终与时间0的排序相反时，时间一致性才被拒绝。我们建立了这一结果的变体与推广形式。由于这种截然相反的逆转现象极少被观察到，选择修正设计所需的识别假设可能比以往所认知的更为严格。但我们证明，在能够对备选方案偏好进行“定价”的环境中，时间不一致性是可识别的。（JEL D11, D15, D83, D86）

title: Competing Diffusions in a Social Network
title_zh: 社交网络中的竞争性扩散
title_primary: 社交网络中的竞争性扩散
title_secondary: Competing Diffusions in a Social Network
authors: Campbell, Arthur, Leister, C. Matthew, Ushchev, Philip, Zenou, Yves
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a model of competing diffusions of goods on a social network. There are two types of goods and individuals: mass-market and niche-market. We find that there is a unique stable steady state and show that the adoption of a massmarket good is greater than its population share. Furthermore, greater connectivity and homophily in the social network will concurrently increase the prevalence of niche-market goods. If there is a strategic agent who wants to promote a niche good, she will invest more in influencing activities than one promoting mass-market goods. When individuals choose their degree of homophily, we show that niche-market individuals exhibit greater homophily than mass-market ones.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个社交网络中商品竞争性扩散的模型。模型包含两类商品与两类个体：大众市场型与利基市场型。研究发现存在唯一稳定的稳态，且大众市场型商品的采纳率高于其人口占比。此外，社交网络中的更高连通性与同质性会同时提升利基市场型商品的普及程度。若存在战略代理人试图推广利基商品，其投入的影响活动成本将高于推广大众市场型商品的代理人。当个体自主选择同质性程度时，我们证明利基市场型个体比大众市场型个体表现出更强的同质性。

title: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
title_zh: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据
title_primary: 职位广告作为信号：来自定价福利与工人信念的证据
title_secondary: Job Ads as Signals: Evidence from a Priced Amenity and Worker Beliefs
authors: Pawel Adrjan, Mária Balgova, Simon Jäger, Jonas Jessen, Jason Sockin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Discrete choice experiments are widely used to estimate workers’ willingness to pay (WTP) for job amenities under the assumption that varying an attribute does not change workers’ beliefs about other job attributes. We test this assumption by embedding an amenity with a known market price—a popular monthly public transport pass—in a largescale discrete choice experiment with German workers. Many workers, including public transport users, overvalue the ticket by more than 100%, despite WTP for other attributes aligning with the literature. A complementary belief-elicitation experiment shows that advertising an amenity, such as the pass but also common amenities like work from home, causally shifts beliefs about unlisted attributes of the job. Posted wages similarly signal unlisted attributes so that wage variation, the money metric for WTP calculation, is itself contaminated by belief spillovers—such as higher pay signaling heightened stress. These spillovers imply that discrete choice estimates capture perceived bundles rather than isolated attributes, and distort current estimates of non-wage compensation and monopsony power.
abstract_zh: 离散选择实验被广泛用于估算工人对工作福利的支付意愿，其前提假设是改变某一属性不会改变工人对其他工作属性的信念。我们通过将一项具有已知市场价格的福利——德国广受欢迎的月度公共交通通票——嵌入针对德国工人的大规模离散选择实验来检验这一假设。结果显示，许多工人（包括公共交通使用者）对该通票的估值高出实际价值100%以上，尽管对其他属性的支付意愿与现有文献一致。一项补充性的信念诱导实验表明，宣传某项福利（如通票，也包括居家办公等常见福利）会因果性地改变工人对工作未列明属性的信念。同样，公布的工资水平也会传递未列明属性的信号，因此作为支付意愿计算货币尺度的工资变动本身也受到信念溢出效应的影响——例如高薪可能意味着更高的工作压力。这些溢出效应意味着离散选择实验的估计结果捕捉到的是感知到的福利组合而非孤立属性，从而扭曲了当前对非工资补偿和买方垄断势力的估算。

title: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
title_zh: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求
title_primary: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求
title_secondary: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
authors: Justin D. Bina
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Demand estimates are commonly used to inform firm strategy and public policy, yet they can obscure important variation in demand across geographic space that is relevant for local business decisions and policy interventions. Prior work documents demand heterogeneity across countries, regions, states, and between coarse urban‐rural categories, but evidence on sub‐metropolitan variation is limited. This study documents within‐metro geographic heterogeneity in market shares and willingness‐to‐pay (WTP) for retail and foodservice protein products. I use nearly six years of publicly available survey data and random parameters logit models that include municipality interactions with alternative‐specific constants and price sensitivity to estimate municipality‐specific market shares and WTP in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Demand varies substantially across adjacent municipalities. Central Phoenix residents exhibit higher retail WTP for conventional beef, pork, and chicken products, while both central Phoenix and Scottsdale‐Tempe residents show consistently higher foodservice WTP. Median WTP in these municipalities is roughly 30–50% higher than in surrounding suburbs, whereas suburban groups exhibit similar valuations to one another. These within‐metro differences are large enough to affect targeted pricing and assortment strategies and to produce uneven distributional welfare effects from local price policies (e.g., taxes). The results suggest that investment in geographically refined demand analyses could better inform policy interventions and business decisions at the local level, where those decisions are often made.
abstract_zh: 摘要 需求估计常用于指导企业战略和公共政策，但可能掩盖地理空间上需求的重要差异，而这些差异与地方商业决策和政策干预密切相关。已有研究记录了国家、地区、州以及城乡粗分类之间的需求异质性，但关于大都市内部次区域差异的证据仍然有限。本研究揭示了凤凰城大都市区内零售和餐饮服务蛋白质产品市场份额及支付意愿（WTP）的地理异质性。利用近六年的公开调查数据，通过随机参数Logit模型（包含市政区与替代特定常数及价格敏感性的交互项），估算了凤凰城大都市区各市政区的市场份额和支付意愿。相邻市政区之间的需求存在显著差异。凤凰城市中心居民对传统牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉产品的零售支付意愿更高，而凤凰城市中心及斯科茨代尔-坦佩居民的餐饮服务支付意愿始终较高。这些市政区的支付意愿中位数比周边郊区高出约30-50%，而郊区群体之间的估值则较为接近。这种大都市内部差异足以影响针对性的定价和品类策略，并导致地方价格政策（如税收）产生不均衡的福利分配效应。研究结果表明，投资于地理精细化需求分析，能够更好地为地方层面的政策干预和商业决策提供信息，而这类决策通常正是在地方层面做出的。

title: Socioecological pathways shape the decoupling of population growth and land loss across Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 社会生态路径塑造撒哈拉以南非洲人口增长与土地流失的脱钩
title_primary: 社会生态路径塑造撒哈拉以南非洲人口增长与土地流失的脱钩
title_secondary: Socioecological pathways shape the decoupling of population growth and land loss across Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Yonas Derebe Derso, Wu Wei, Meseret C. Abate, Haile Ketema, Abay Bantihun 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Achieving development within planetary boundaries faces its most acute challenge in Sub-Saharan Africa, where rapid population growth intensifies land use pressure. Yet, it remains unclear whether, where, and to what extent population growth can decouple from land loss across the region. Here we address this gap by developing a multiscale research framework to examine population and land loss decoupling from 1990 to 2050 under the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs). We combine Tapio elasticity analysis with a Geographically Weighted Elastic Net model to quantify decoupling at pixel, national, and biome scales. Our results show that decoupling is limited in extent and structurally weak across scales. Most pixels exhibited no change, and where change occurred, weak decoupling (WD) dominated with elasticities clustered near zero. Spatial heterogeneity is evident, with localized hotspots of strong decoupling (SD) and coupling coexist. Ecological context conditions decoupling capacity; humid and semi-humid forest systems maintaining more stable decoupling than dryland and Mediterranean systems. Over time, stronger divergence in the 1990s weakens toward a more constrained quasi-equilibrium. Future decoupling trajectories are pathway dependent. SSP1 and SSP2 stabilize WD, whereas SSP3 and SSP4 slightly increase SD prevalence while reducing weak negative decoupling. These findings indicate that land loss dynamics in SSA are shaped not by population growth alone, but by the interaction of ecological conditions, spatial scale, and socioeconomic development pathways. This emphasizes the need for land use policies that are spatially differentiated, ecologically sensitive, and aligned with long-term development pathways.
abstract_zh: 在行星边界内实现发展所面临的最严峻挑战位于撒哈拉以南非洲，那里快速的人口增长加剧了土地利用压力。然而，该地区人口增长能否与土地流失脱钩、在何处脱钩以及脱钩程度如何，目前仍不清楚。本研究通过构建一个多尺度研究框架，考察1990年至2050年间在共享社会经济路径（SSPs）下人口与土地流失的脱钩情况，以填补这一研究空白。我们将Tapio弹性分析与地理加权弹性网络模型相结合，在像元、国家和生物群落尺度上量化脱钩程度。结果表明，脱钩在范围上有限，且在跨尺度上结构薄弱。大多数像元未表现出变化，而在发生变化的区域，弱脱钩（WD）占主导地位，弹性值聚集于零附近。空间异质性明显，强脱钩（SD）与耦合的局部热点并存。生态背景条件制约着脱钩能力；湿润和半湿润森林系统比旱地和地中海系统维持更稳定的脱钩状态。随时间推移，20世纪90年代较强的分化趋势逐渐减弱，趋向于更为受限的准平衡状态。未来脱钩轨迹依赖于路径选择。SSP1和SSP2使弱脱钩趋于稳定，而SSP3和SSP4则略微提高了强脱钩的发生率，同时减少了弱负脱钩。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的土地流失动态并非仅由人口增长单独塑造，而是生态条件、空间尺度和社会经济发展路径相互作用的结果。这强调了制定空间差异化、生态敏感且与长期发展路径相一致的土地利用政策的必要性。

title: The impact of low-altitude economy city pilot policy on enterprise total factor productivity: evidence from China

authors: Lin Wang, Fengqin Liu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The low-altitude economy, as an emerging economic form integrating aviation technology, digital technologies, and traditional industries, has in recent years been recognized as a new engine driving economic transformation and upgrading. Drawing on endogenous growth theory and the analytical framework of emerging productivity, this study examines the impact of the low-altitude economy (LAE) city pilot policy on enterprise total factor productivity (TFP). Utilizing panel data from Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share listed companies between 2016 and 2023, we examine the underlying mechanisms using a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) approach. The results demonstrate that low-altitude economy city pilot policy significantly enhances enterprise TFP. The low-altitude economy city pilot policy can optimize capital allocation, enhance supply chain collaboration, and advance technological progress, and thereby contribute to improving enterprise TFP. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that the TFP-enhancing is more pronounced for technology-intensive and manufacturing enterprises, as well as for firms located in regions characterized by stronger intellectual property protection. This study provides empirical evidence on the micro-level mechanisms of new-type productivity from the perspective of the low-altitude economy and offers policy insights for developing economies.
abstract_zh: 低空经济作为融合航空技术、数字技术与传统产业的新兴经济形态，近年来被视为推动经济转型升级的新引擎。本研究基于内生增长理论与新质生产力的分析框架，探讨低空经济城市试点政策对企业全要素生产率的影响。利用2016至2023年间上海和深圳A股上市公司的面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分法考察其内在机制。结果表明，低空经济城市试点政策显著提升了企业全要素生产率。低空经济城市试点政策能够优化资本配置、增强供应链协同并促进技术进步，从而有助于提高企业全要素生产率。异质性分析显示，对于技术密集型企业和制造业企业，以及位于知识产权保护较强地区的企业，全要素生产率的提升效应更为显著。本研究从低空经济视角提供了新质生产力微观机制的经验证据，并为发展中经济体提供了政策启示。

title: Granular and spatially differentiated density thresholds for No Net Land Take: A scenario-based cellular automata analysis in French territories
title_zh: 无净土地占用的颗粒化与空间差异化密度阈值：基于情景的法国领土元胞自动机分析

title_secondary: Granular and spatially differentiated density thresholds for No Net Land Take: A scenario-based cellular automata analysis in French territories
authors: Igor Agbossou, Tudal Sinsin, Jean-Philippe Antoni, Gilles Vuidel, Edouard Patault
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The "No Net Land Take" (NNLT) objective – halting land artificialization by 2050 – poses a fundamental planning challenge: how to accommodate housing demand without new land take. This paper addresses two issues. First: by demonstrating that achieving Net No Land Take (NNLT) requires moving beyond uniform average density targets toward spatially differentiated density thresholds adapted to local urban contexts. Second: by establishing that spatial computing methodologies, particularly high-resolution cellular automata modeling, provide an appropriate framework for defining and testing such granular density thresholds under NNLT constraints. To investigate these issues, we employ the LucSim high-resolution cellular automata model to simulate five density scenarios up to 2050 across two contrasting French territories: the demographically dynamic peri-metropolitan Grand Rovaltain (GR) and the ecologically sensitive, tourism-driven Aire Gapençaise (AG). Simulations are calibrated with official 2050 housing targets from their respective Territorial Coherence Schemes (SCoT) and translated into six settlement entity‑specific density thresholds to test whether granular spatialization matters. Methodologically, cellular automata prove appropriate for this task because they spatially allocate densification under policy constraints while preserving local morphological realism. Our results show that higher-density scenarios can substantially limit land artificialization and protect high-quality soils. However, the effectiveness of densification strategies strongly depends on regional socio-economic and biophysical contexts. This study provides a quantitative, scenario-based framework for policymakers, emphasizing that context-sensitive densification is essential for reconciling urban development with environmental sustainability.
abstract_zh: 零净土地占用”（NNLT）目标——即到2050年停止土地人工化——构成了一个根本性的规划挑战：如何在不对新土地进行占用的前提下满足住房需求。本文探讨了两个问题。首先，通过论证实现零净土地占用（NNLT）需要超越统一的平均密度目标，转向适应地方城市背景的空间差异化密度阈值。其次，通过确立空间计算方法，特别是高分辨率元胞自动机建模，为在NNLT约束下定义和测试此类精细密度阈值提供了合适的框架。为探究这些问题，我们运用LucSim高分辨率元胞自动机模型，在法国两个对比鲜明的地区模拟了至2050年的五种密度情景：人口动态增长的城郊大罗瓦尔坦（GR）地区和生态敏感、以旅游业驱动的艾尔加彭斯（AG）地区。模拟依据各自《领土协调规划》（SCoT）中的官方2050年住房目标进行校准，并将其转化为六个聚落实体特定的密度阈值，以检验精细空间化是否具有重要性。在方法论上，元胞自动机被证明适用于此任务，因为它们在政策约束下对密度提升进行空间分配，同时保持地方形态学的真实性。我们的结果表明，较高密度的情景能够显著限制土地人工化并保护优质土壤。然而，密度提升策略的有效性在很大程度上取决于区域的社会经济和生物物理背景。本研究为政策制定者提供了一个基于情景的量化框架，强调情境敏感的密度提升对于协调城市发展与环境可持续性至关重要。

title: Citizenship Policy and the Spread of Communicable Diseases: Evidence from the Dominican Republic

authors: Fabiola Alba-Vivar, Eduardo Campillo-Betancourt, Jose Luis Flor-Toro
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate the causal effect of exclusionary citizenship policies on communicable disease transmission. In 2013, the Dominican Republic's Constitutional Court Ruling 168-13 retroactively revoked citizenship from roughly 10 percent of the population—primarily individuals of Haitian descent—thereby restricting their access to healthcare. Leveraging municipality-level variation in exposure within a difference-in-differences framework as well as individual administrative data, we identify a two-stage dynamic in dengue incidence. In the short run, reported cases decline by 13.5 percent in high-exposure municipalities, consistent with healthcare avoidance among affected populations. This decline reverses after six months, as untreated infections generate spillover transmission to non-Haitian populations, increasing cases by 16.7 percent. Overall, the findings demonstrate that restricting healthcare access through citizenship policy imposes substantial public health costs that extend beyond the targeted population.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了排他性公民身份政策对传染病传播的因果效应。2013年，多米尼加共和国宪法法院第168-13号裁决追溯性地剥夺了约10%人口（主要是海地裔）的公民身份，从而限制了他们获得医疗服务的权利。利用市级层面暴露程度的差异，结合双重差分框架及个体行政数据，我们识别出登革热发病率的两个阶段动态变化。短期内，高暴露地区的报告病例下降13.5%，这与受影响人群回避就医的行为一致。六个月后，这一下降趋势发生逆转，未治疗的感染引发向非海地人群的溢出传播，导致病例增加16.7%。总体而言，研究结果表明，通过公民身份政策限制医疗获取权会带来巨大的公共卫生成本，且其影响超出了目标人群本身。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了数字连接对越南女性户主家庭收入的影响。基于越南数字经济接入指数与越南家庭生活水平调查数据，实证结果表明：数字连接的增强显著提升了女性户主家庭的收入水平。教育程度有限、收入水平较低及居住在农村地区的弱势群体，从数字连接中获益更多。我们进一步探究了该影响的作用机制，发现数字连接与劳动力市场参与度的提升密切相关，尤其在服务业领域。本研究为数字连接的包容性效应提供了新见解，并为推进数字基础设施建设提出了政策建议。

abstract: This paper examines the effects of privatizing social health insurance. We exploit a natural experiment in Medicaid, wherein nearly 100,000 enrollees were randomly assigned between a publicly operated fee-for-service system and private managed care. Managed care reduced costs by 5.6 percent via cost-effective substitutions among prescription drugs and via lower prices for outpatient services. We present evidence that pharmacy utilization management was the key mechanism reducing overuse and encouraging substitution to lower-cost drugs without decreasing observed quality. In contrast, privatizing medical benefits led to only modest savings and was associated with decreased health care quality and consumer satisfaction. (JEL G22, H41, I13, I18, I38)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了社会医疗保险私有化的影响。我们利用医疗补助计划中的一项自然实验，将近10万名参保者随机分配至公共运营的按服务收费体系与私人管理式医疗体系中。管理式医疗通过处方药的成本效益替代以及降低门诊服务价格，使成本降低了5.6%。我们提供的证据表明，药房利用管理是减少过度用药、鼓励替代为低成本药物且不降低可观测质量的关键机制。相比之下，医疗福利的私有化仅带来适度节约，且与医疗质量下降及消费者满意度降低相关。（JEL分类号：G22, H41, I13, I18, I38）

abstract: Abstract Traditional foods (often referred to as “country foods”) play a critical role in Indigenous culture, nutrition, food sovereignty and food security. Policies that prioritize store‐bought food are often viewed as undermining these foods. We provide evidence that two recent policy reforms that subsidize store‐bought food in the Northwest Territories do not appear to negatively impact traditional foods. Our analysis uses community surveys conducted in the Northwest Territories that measure the importance of consumption and production of traditional country food along several margins. Using a difference‐in‐differences methodology, we show that two transitions associated with the Nutrition North Canada subsidy program—the transition from Food Mail to Nutrition North from 2011 to 2012 and the expansion of subsidy eligibility to new communities in 2016—had a zero or positive impact on these outcomes. We use price and quantity data from multiple sources to provide evidence on mechanisms and find support for an interpretation based on country foods having a high income elasticity and low substitutability with store‐bought meat and other foods.
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统食物（常被称为“乡村食物”）在土著文化、营养、食物主权和食物安全中扮演着关键角色。优先考虑商店购买食品的政策常被视为削弱这些传统食物。我们提供的证据表明，西北地区近期两项补贴商店购买食品的政策改革似乎并未对传统食物产生负面影响。我们的分析利用在西北地区进行的社区调查，这些调查从多个维度衡量了传统乡村食物消费和生产的重要性。采用双重差分方法，我们显示与“营养北方加拿大”补贴计划相关的两次转变——2011年至2012年从“食品邮件”向“营养北方”的过渡，以及2016年补贴资格扩展至新社区——对这些结果产生了零或正面的影响。我们利用多来源的价格和数量数据来提供机制证据，并支持一种基于乡村食物具有高收入弹性且与商店购买的肉类及其他食品替代性低的解释。

abstract: We investigate whether different criteria are used in evaluating male and female leaders when outcomes are determined by unobservable choices and luck. Evaluators form beliefs about leaders’ choices (perceived intentions) and make discretionary payments. We find that while payments to male leaders are determined by both outcomes and perceived intentions, those to female leaders are determined by outcomes only. We label this new source of gender bias as the gender criteria gap . Our findings imply that high outcomes are necessary for women to get bonuses, but men can receive bonuses for low outcomes if evaluators hold them in high regard.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了当结果由不可观测的选择和运气决定时，评价男性与女性领导者是否采用不同标准。评价者会形成对领导者选择（感知意图）的信念，并据此进行酌情支付。研究发现，男性领导者的薪酬由结果和感知意图共同决定，而女性领导者的薪酬仅由结果决定。我们将这种新的性别偏见来源称为"性别标准差异"。研究结果表明，高绩效是女性获得奖金的必要条件，但若评价者对男性评价较高，即使其绩效较低，男性仍可获得奖金。

abstract: While extensive literature has explored the implications of artificial intelligence (AI) and government procurement in driving technological evolution and economic growth, the relationship between AI intensity and government procurement remains underexamined. This paper shifts focus to digital government procurement (DGP) and empirically examines its impact on corporate AI intensity using a sample of Chinese A-share listed firms from 2015 to 2022 with a two-way fixed effects model. The results demonstrate a significantly positive association between DGP and AI intensity, which holds robust across a series of robustness tests. Further analysis suggests that DGP promotes AI intensity by easing financing constraints, improving managerial capability, and enhancing human capital. The promotion effect of DGP on AI intensity is stronger for private firms, regions with higher institutional quality, and for procurement conducted by non-university government entities. This study broadens the theoretical boundary of the economic outcomes of government procurement and determinants of AI adoption, offering valuable practical implications for designing procurement strategies that effectively foster corporate AI advancement.
abstract_zh: 尽管已有大量文献探讨了人工智能（AI）与政府采购在推动技术演进和经济增长方面的作用，但AI强度与政府采购之间的关系仍未得到充分研究。本文将焦点转向数字政府采购（DGP），并利用2015年至2022年中国A股上市公司的样本，通过双向固定效应模型实证检验其对企业的AI强度的影响。结果显示，DGP与AI强度之间存在显著的正相关关系，这一结论在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步分析表明，DGP通过缓解融资约束、提升管理能力和增强人力资本来促进AI强度。对于民营企业、制度质量较高的地区以及非大学政府实体进行的采购，DGP对AI强度的促进作用更为显著。本研究拓宽了政府采购经济后果及AI采纳决定因素的理论边界，为设计有效促进企业AI发展的采购策略提供了宝贵的实践启示。

abstract: We use equity returns to construct a time-varying measure of the zero-beta interest rate: the expected return of a stock portfolio orthogonal to the stochastic discount factor. In contrast to safe rates, the zero-beta rate fits the aggregate consumption Euler equation remarkably well both unconditionally and conditional on monetary policy shocks and is high, volatile, and persistent enough to explain the average return and most of the volatility of the market portfolio. The puzzle is why safe rates are so low, stable, and disconnected from both consumption and the zero-beta rate.
abstract_zh: 我们利用股票收益率构建了一个随时间变化的零贝塔利率度量：即与随机贴现因子正交的股票投资组合的预期收益率。与安全利率相比，零贝塔利率在无条件情况下及货币政策冲击条件下均能极好地拟合总体消费欧拉方程，并且其水平高、波动大且持久性强，足以解释市场组合的平均回报及其大部分波动性。谜团在于，为何安全利率如此之低、稳定，且与消费及零贝塔利率均脱节。

abstract: This paper investigates how cashless payment affects credit access for underserved populations using data from Alipay, a leading Chinese BigTech platform with over 1 billion users that offers a wide range of financial services. By exploiting the staggered rollout of Alipay-bundled shared bikes across cities as a natural experiment and analyzing a representative Alipay user sample, I find that cashless payment adoption increases credit access by 56.3% and that a 1% rise in payment flow increases credit lines by 0.41%. These effects are stronger for less educated and older individuals, who have traditionally faced greater barriers to accessing financial services.
abstract_zh: 本文利用中国领先的BigTech平台——支付宝（拥有超过10亿用户，提供广泛金融服务）的数据，探讨无现金支付如何影响弱势群体的信贷获取。通过将支付宝捆绑共享单车在各城市的逐步推广作为自然实验，并分析具有代表性的支付宝用户样本，我发现无现金支付的采纳使信贷获取增加了56.3%，且支付流量每增加1%，信贷额度相应提高0.41%。这些效应在受教育程度较低及年龄较大的个体中更为显著，而这一群体历来在获取金融服务方面面临更大障碍。

abstract: Dollar store proliferation across the United States since the early 2000s has prompted numerous communities to enact policies restricting their growth. Motivated by policy concerns about reduced food access, we investigate whether dollar store entry reduces access to grocery stores, measured by the presence of grocery stores near households. We find significant effects in urban block groups that experience dollar store entry with a single grocery store at baseline, constituting 14% of treated urban block groups from 2006 to 2020. Urban-area impacts are strongly correlated with the Black population share, poverty rate, dependence on public assistance, and levels of vacant housing and vehicle access. Rural-area effects are negligible or zero in our main analyses, though incorporating smaller retailers in our food access definition reveals modest but significant impacts. Food access concerns driving dollar store policies may be valid in specific communities.
abstract_zh: 自21世纪初以来，美元商店在美国的迅速扩张促使众多社区制定了限制其增长的政策。鉴于对食品获取渠道减少的政策担忧，我们研究了美元商店的进入是否降低了家庭附近杂货店的可及性，以家庭周边是否存在杂货店为衡量标准。我们发现，在基线时仅有一家杂货店的城市街区组中，美元商店的进入产生了显著影响，这些街区组占2006年至2020年受处理城市街区组的14%。城市区域的影响与黑人人口比例、贫困率、对公共援助的依赖程度以及空置住房和车辆拥有水平密切相关。在我们的主要分析中，农村地区的影响可忽略不计或为零，但将较小零售商纳入食品获取定义后，则显示出虽温和但显著的影响。推动美元商店政策的食品获取担忧在特定社区中可能确实成立。

title: COVID-19 and Cost Stickiness: the Impact of the Pandemic on Resource Management Decisions
title_primary: COVID-19 and Cost Stickiness: the Impact of the Pandemic on Resource Management Decisions
authors: Seung Jae Lee, Hyeonjung Kim, Joohyung Lee
official: 官方在线 2025-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on corporate executives’ cost management decisions during revenue declines. Managers often cut costs in response to poor performance, but this approach during a downturn can lead to higher costs when sales recover. Such decisions depend on management’s expectations about the upcoming market. At the start of the pandemic, firms had to assess the potential severity and duration of COVID-19 and manage resources accordingly. This research explores (1) the management’s perception of the pandemic as a short- or long-term event and (2) changes in cost behaviour before and after COVID-19, especially regarding executives’ uncertainty perceptions. Pre-COVID-19 findings indicate that firms displayed cost stickiness, aligning with previous studies that demonstrate costs decrease less during sales declines than they increase during sales rises. Post-COVID-19, this stickiness weakened, with costs adjusting more symmetrically to revenue changes. These results highlight how executives’ expectations and perceptions of uncertainty during the global crisis affected firm resource management, leading to changes in asymmetric cost behaviours.

title: Marketization of data elements and new-quality productivity: a quasi-natural experiment based on data trading platforms

abstract: This study aims to explore how the market-oriented development of data elements can drive an innovative ‘1+N’ configuration of production factors, enhance synergistic innovation, boost total factor productivity, and support the connotative growth of new-quality productivity. This study, based on data from 274 prefecture-level cities in China from 2012 to 2023, treats the establishment of data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment and constructs a progressive difference-in-differences (DID) model to analyse the impact of the marketization of data elements on new quality productivity and its underlying mechanisms. Results indicate that data element marketization, exemplified by data trading platforms, significantly enhances new-quality productivity. This effect exhibits spatial spillover, promoting local development while driving neighbouring cities to cultivate new-quality productivity. Mechanism analysis reveals that data element marketization boosts new-quality productivity by encouraging disruptive technological innovation and fostering deep integration of digital economy and real economy. Heterogeneity analysis indicates stronger effects in large-scale, innovative, and high-market-potential cities. The research findings reveal the technological and economic paradigm innovation effect of data element reallocation, providing policy insights for the government to further promote its innovation-driven strategy and theoretical basis and empirical evidence for cultivating new-quality productivity under the new development pattern.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨数据要素市场化发展如何驱动创新性“1+N”生产要素配置，增强协同创新，提升全要素生产率，并支撑新质生产力的内涵式增长。基于2012年至2023年中国274个地级市的数据，本研究将数据交易平台的设立视为准自然实验，构建渐进式双重差分（DID）模型，分析数据要素市场化对新质生产力的影响及其内在机制。结果表明，以数据交易平台为代表的数据要素市场化显著提升了新质生产力。该效应具有空间溢出性，在促进本地发展的同时，也带动邻近城市培育新质生产力。机制分析显示，数据要素市场化通过鼓励颠覆性技术创新和促进数字经济与实体经济深度融合来提升新质生产力。异质性分析表明，在规模较大、创新活跃及市场潜力高的城市中，该效应更为显著。研究结果揭示了数据要素重新配置的技术与经济范式创新效应，为政府进一步推进创新驱动战略提供了政策启示，也为新发展格局下培育新质生产力提供了理论基础与实证依据。
